source.title: The Salvagematic 9000!
source.description: Insert your salvage into the machine, get fabulous prizes! Probably. Maybe.
source.objective: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Salvage into the Salvagematic 9000, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
source.progress: The machine shudders and shakes before belching out a pile of salvaged parts.
